items.title: Spider Peeking from a Pumpkin
items.alt: A cheerful black spider spreads eight legs over the rim of an open orange pumpkin with its lid leaning beside it.
items.description: A cheerful black spider spreads eight legs over the rim of an open orange pumpkin with its lid leaning beside it. Useful for personal Halloween crafts.

items.title: Spider beside a Teapot
items.alt: A brown spider seen from above spreads eight legs beside a teal floral teapot and matching cup of tea.
items.description: A brown spider seen from above spreads eight legs beside a teal floral teapot and matching cup of tea. Useful for imaginative tea party stories.

items.title: Spider with a Mixing Bowl
items.alt: A smiling gray spider wearing a white chef hat lifts its two short front legs above an ivory bowl with a wooden spoon resting across the rim.
items.description: A smiling gray spider wearing a white chef hat sits above an ivory bowl and wooden spoon. Useful for personal baking story cards.
